race.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Handicap
race.verdict: BENACRE is well handicapped on last winter's form and could prove a different proposition with visor applied and freshened up by a break. He therefore looks worth chancing. Lillie Margot has a solid-looking profile and shouldn't be far away, while Orangesandlemons won over C&D in the past and may do better down in grade. BENACRE (IRE) LILLIE MARGOT ORANGESANDLEMONS
